name: Fail-closed source security
description: Reusable invariants for authorization and external evidence handling.
invariants: Every public write that changes privileged state authenticates the transaction sender before the mutation.
A non-success HTTP response cannot produce an approval or verified outcome.
Every externally supplied GitHub file is fetched using the submitted immutable commit SHA as the API ref.
The overall verified outcome is derived by deterministic code and is not accepted directly from an LLM.
